messages:
maya: Heads up — we're pushing an audit event schema tweak that affects KMS access events and RBAC-change records. Need quick customer-facing samples + docs copy before next week's release. :eyes:

jake: can you paste the minimal sample payload we'll show customers? cc @legal-team for any PII concerns.

maya: sure, here's the trimmed example i'll put in the draft changelog + docs. we only include non-sensitive identifiers and derive email hashes when required.

```json
{
  "event_type": "kms.key_access",
  "schema_version": "audit/v3",
  "timestamp": "2025-01-10T15:22:10Z",
  "principal": { "id": "user-12ab", "display_name": "alice@example.com", "principal_type": "user" },
  "resource": { "type": "kms_key", "name": "projects/prod/keys/rdw-key-01" },
  "action": "decrypt",
  "outcome": "success",
  "rbac_delta": { "from_version": "v1", "to_version": "v2", "changes": [ "grant:service-account:read" ] },
  "context": { "request_id": "req-9876", "region": "us-west-2" }
}
```

sophia: looks good. small ask: under "principal.display_name" don't show full emails in customer samples. show hashed_email or display alias. can we update example to `display_alias: "alice@redacted"`?

maya: yep updated in docs draft. we'll keep full email only in the internal sample-pack (for customer support + incident triage) and redact in public-facing docs.

raj: quick question re: RBAC diffs — will we emit the full policy diff or only the high-level delta? customers asked for both granular diffs and sanitized summaries.

maya: plan is: internal stream has full diffs (policy statements), public stream provides summarized `changes` array and an optional `diff_id` customers can request via support with justification. avoids leaking role/principal enumerations.

jake: that sounds reasonable. please add an opt-in flag for customers who want full diffs to the Dedicated + Private docs.

legal-team: reviewed sample. two notes: 1) remove direct IPs from public examples; 2) ensure retention text in changelog refers to configurable retention in the Console, not hard-coded values. otherwise fine. :white_check_mark:

maya: noted. i'll update the public sample to hash ip and replace with `ip_hash` and add a retention blurb.

security-bot: Automated check: sample schema passes schema-v3 syntactic validation. No disallowed fields detected.

maya: next steps: 1) docs PR with the public sample + changelog blurb (who can review?) 2) internal sample-pack (include full email + IP) + support script 3) announcement draft for staging customers for validation.

sophia: i'll review docs PR today. can you also add a short FAQ entry: "why do we remove emails in public examples" and mention legal + privacy rationale.

maya: will do. drafting changelog blurb now: 

- "Audit schema v3: expanded KMS/key_access events and structured RBAC delta field. Public samples redact PII (emails, IPs); Dedicated/Private customers can opt into receiving richer diffs via support."

jake: put that in `changelogs/audit/CHANGELOG.md` and ping eng-releases. also add a migration note for customers consuming `audit/v2` streams.

maya: added migration note: "Consumers should switch to schema `audit/v3` — new `rbac_delta` field replaces previous freeform policy blobs. See migration examples in docs."

raj: vuln triage note: this change touches KMS auditing path — please include a test that ensures events are logged even when KMS returns partial failures. we had an issue last year where failed decrypts were swallowed.

maya: good catch, adding a unit + e2e test. will include a failing-case sample in the internal sample-pack.

security-bot: Deploy check queued — docs PR needs to pass link-checker and sensitive-data scan.

maya: ETA for PR by EOD. once docs PR is green i'll share the public sample link and the staging announcement. thanks all. :thumbsup:

jake: thanks — ping me when changelog is live and i'll prep the customer email template.

legal-team: approved language for announcement subject line: "Upcoming audit logging schema updates (action optional)"

maya: saving that. last item: who covers customer validation window next week? need one eng + one security + sam from support.
sophia: i can cover eng. raj can you take security?

raj: yep i can.

maya: perfect. i'll schedule the validation session and post notes in #incidents after we exercise a few edge cases.

security-bot: Thread archived to audit-change-2025 channel archive.
